description: This file defines a class 'Membership' which extends ListableDisplayField. It is part of a reporting system for a Human Resource Management (HRM) application, specifying display fields related to membership data within the report. The class provides methods to specify the DTO class, entity aliases, and fields used in the report.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a display field for membership data in HRM report, extending the ListableDisplayField class and specifying relevant DTO, entity alias, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description:
Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, 'Dto\[Membership\n
doctrine class or data transfer object for membership data.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases, in this case ['membership'], used in constructing queries or identifiers.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields used for display or querying, specifically ['employee.empNumber'] for this membership display field.
